title.narrative: Strengthening MEL capacities in LAC region

description.narrative: This project’s objective is: - To enable the LAC team and in particular, partner-facing staff, to introduce and pilot Outcome Harvesting as a methodology with selected partners in the LAC region. This will be the first phase of a process in which OH will be introduced and piloted in the LAC region. It is meant to present OH in a practical, simple manner, enabling LAC team to introduce this both with partners who have strong MEL organisational capacities as well as those who are grassroots, community-based organisations with little to no MEL expertise. Thus, the depth and scope of the materials and sessions should stay at that introductory level, while covering enough for teams and partners to pilot OH sessions within this project cycle and this year’s work (FY 24-25). We will do this by hiring an external MEL expert consultant to deliver on the following outputs: This FY 23-24: - Develop training materials & introductory tools on Outcome Harvesting for both LAC team & partners (English and Spanish) (March 2024). Next FY 24-25: - Deliver online participatory training sessions for LAC team to introduce OH methodology and build enough capacity to pilot this introductory level with partners (May & June 2024). - Deliver one in-person workshop (1 or 2 days) to LAC team to put previous knowledge and skills in practice and focus on OH facilitation with partners (Week of July 8th, preferably on July 12th 2024). - Hold “helpdesk” or Q&A sessions with LAC teams/colleagues in preparation of and after piloting OH sessions with partners (total of 3 preparatory and 3 reflection & feedback sessions). - Hold 1-2 sessions with CAFOD’s learning advisor to understand approach and facilitate cross-learning on OH across the various International Programmes.
